## Type Aliases

### PixelNumberSize

```ts
type PixelNumberSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl";
```

### PixelNumberProps

```ts
type PixelNumberProps = Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "children"> &
  object;
```

Props accepted by PixelNumber. Pass a `value`, or readout `text`.

#### Type Declaration

| Name       | Type                                  | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value?`   | `number`                              | A number to draw.                                                                                                                      |
| `text?`    | `string`                              | Readout text instead of a number: digits and `: . + - / × %` and spaces.                                                               |
| `pad?`     | `number`                              | Left-pad the whole part of `value` with zeros to this many digits.                                                                     |
| `signed?`  | `boolean`                             | Prefix a positive `value` with `+`, for gains and floating numbers.                                                                    |
| `size?`    | [`PixelNumberSize`](#pixelnumbersize) | -                                                                                                                                      |
| `tone?`    | [`PixelNumberTone`](#pixelnumbertone) | -                                                                                                                                      |
| `outline?` | `boolean`                             | Ring every lit pixel with the ink line, like a sprite outline, so the number reads over any world: damage, pickups and floating gains. |

### PixelNumber

```ts
const PixelNumber: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "children"> &
    object &
    RefAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>
>;
```

Crisp pixel numerals drawn as SVG, so they stay sharp at every size and never
depend on a font file. The readable text is kept for assistive tech.
